GuroPrep · Weekly prep

Teacher originals

Prepare an original worksheet, lesson or activity for the GuroPrep pilot. You can download a submission pack to share with your pilot coordinator. Public listings, purchases and payouts are not open yet.

Share a free resource

At 100 valid downloads, a work earns ₱10. Each additional valid download adds ₱0.10, up to ₱100 per work at 1,000 downloads. Only the first download by another teacher account counts.

Set a selling price

You set the price. For each completed, unrefunded sale you receive 70% and GuroPrep receives 30%. The free-download cap applies only to free works.

What happens to your rights?

Saving a lesson or preparing this pack keeps it private in your browser. Sharing a pack for review does not transfer rights. If GuroPrep accepts your work, you will receive a separate written agreement naming the rights holder and the work before any transfer takes effect.

Under the proposed agreement, GuroPrep acquires the transferable economic rights. You keep author credit and permission to use and adapt the work for your own classes. If a free work later becomes paid, its author receives the same 70% share of sales. Rejected works stay with their rights holders.

Submit only work you have authority to transfer. Check school or government ownership and permissions for illustrations, passages and co-authored work. Remove learner names and photos.
